The '''Freedom One''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was formerly known as the '''Stormtrooper One''' prior to SoroSuub changing its allegiance and throwing its support to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Stormtrooper One was a clone of the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 rifle]], and saw far less use than that weapon, though the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] war machine did use both products.

Its frame was a simple tubular design, with most of the internal components having been designed to wrap around the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. As such, the barrel ran more or less the entire length of the weapon. As a result, it had good long range accuracy in spite of its compactness, and packed a powerful punch, though not nearly as much as BlasTech's [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280]].

There were three settings for the Stormtrooper One: single fire, short bursts, and potentially barrel-damaging full auto-fire. The weapon's sighting package included a computer-enhanced scope, and simple iron sights in case the scope fails in combat. The most apparent weakness of the rifle was the flimsiness of the folding wire-frame shoulder [[Stock/Legends|stock]].
